title: Traveler's Rest
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘Traveler’s Rest’ a Luxury 7 Bedroom, 8.5 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this gated beach home offers a private pool, spa and a 6-seater Golf Cart!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • 7 Bedrooms & 8.5 Full Baths • Sleeps: 20 • 4 Stories & 5,222 Square Feet • 6 Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • Carriage House • Private Pool with Water Feature (Pool can be heated for an additional $60 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) • Summer Kitchen • Firepit • Observation Tower • Elevator • Baby Gates on each level of main house • Gated • Parking for 6 Vehicles DESCRIPTION: Experience the ultimate in privacy, luxury, and coastal elegance at Traveler’s Rest, Inlet Beach's most sophisticated retreat. This remarkable home combines timeless design with modern amenities, creating the perfect setting for your dream vacation. Boasting expansive living areas for grand gatherings and intimate private spaces for quiet relaxation, the home’s thoughtful layout seamlessly blends elegant interiors with serene outdoor settings. Enjoy a garden terrace to the east, a charming central courtyard, and an abundance of natural light throughout. Traveler's Rest invites you to pause, reflect and find solace in a world that often moves too fast. It is a sanctuary where the journey becomes the destination, offering a sense of peace and rejuvenation. The spacious design and thoughtful details beckon you to find rest and renewal, allowing you to create meaningful connections and lasting memories. This magnificent 7-bedroom, 8.5-bathroom estate is designed to exceed expectations. Perfect for large groups, the property includes a private pool with an adjacent outdoor bath, an outdoor kitchen for alfresco dining, and stunning reclaimed materials like 10-inch-wide heart pine floors from an 1860 Kentucky barn and an oyster shell chimney with Pecky cypress ceilings. The fully equipped gourmet kitchen features Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, dual dishwashers, an ice machine, and a wine refrigerator, offering everything you need for an elevated culinary experience. Each bedroom is appointed with its own en-suite bathroom, ensuring ultimate comfort and privacy for every guest. With three laundry areas, this home is as functional as it is beautiful. Seven outdoor porches and a rooftop deck with 180-degree Gulf views provide breathtaking settings for relaxation. Additional highlights include an elevator for easy access across all floors, a sophisticated sound system indoors and around the pool, and charming touches like a cozy bunk nook and a majestic rooftop retreat with bed swings. The carriage house offers its own luxurious experience, complete with a king bed, a full kitchen, a living area, and laundry facilities, making it ideal for extended family or guests. Located just a block from the "Wall Street" public beach access, this gated estate ensures unmatched privacy and security, providing a peaceful escape for your group. Create unforgettable memories at Traveler’s Rest, a home that embodies the song’s message of rest and renewal. With luxurious amenities, breathtaking views, and unrivaled comfort, this Inlet Beach estate invites you to step away from life’s hustle and embrace the beauty of the moment. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 20) FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 2) • Bedroom 1: Guest Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Soaking Tub & Tile/Glass Walk-in Shower + Front Load Washer & Dryer in Closet SECOND FLOOR: (Sleeps 6) • Bedroom 2: Primary Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Soaking Tub & Tile/Glass Walk-in Shower + Private Balcony • Bedroom 3: Guest Suite with Two Twin Beds (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Shower/Tub Combination + Private Balcony • Bedroom 4: Guest Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower THIRD FLOOR (Sleeps 8) • Bedroom 5: Guest Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower + Private Balcony • Bedroom 6: Bunk Room (sleeps 6) with One Twin Over Twin Bunk & One Full over Full Bunk - Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower CARRIAGE HOUSE (Sleeps 4) • Bedroom 7: Guest Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower • Queen Sleeper Sofa in Living Room (sleeps 2) LAYOUT FIRST FLOOR: • Main Living Area with Fireplace, Sofa & Four Arm Chairs • Culinary Kitchen: Wolf Oven & Range, Sub-Zero Fridge, & Dual Dishwasher • Large Island Seats 5 • Dining Area Seats 8 • Half Bath • King Guest Suite with ensuite bath & laundry facilities • Elevator SECOND FLOOR: • Media Room with Sofa and Arm Chair & Access to Balcony • Primary Guest Suite with Ensuite Bathroom & Balcony • Guest Suite with Two Twin Beds, Ensuite Bathroom & Balcony • King Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom • Laundry Room with Front Load Washer & Dryer with Sink and Folding Area THIRD FLOOR: • King Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom + Balcony • Bunk Room a Twin over Twin Bunk & a Queen over Queen Bunk; Ensuite Bathroom • Laundry room with front load washer & dryer + Sink • Wet Bar with Ice Machine & Sink • Access to the Rooftop Terrace with Gulf Views & Two Bench Swings CARRIAGE HOUSE • Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa • Full Kitchen with Stove, Oven, Dishwasher & Fridge • King Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom OUTDOOR: • Gated with Parking for 6 Cars • Heated Private Pool with Water Feature – 4 Loungers + Umbrella • Summer Kitchen with Grill, Sink , Ice Machine & Wine Fridge • Pool Bath with Shower • Outdoor Firepit • Screened Porch with Bench Swing • Large Deck for Dining • Rooftop Terrace with Two Bench Swings & Gulf Views • Beach Access Steps Away CONVENIENT LOCATION: • Rosemary Beach (~0.3 miles) • Boutique shops, art galleries, and gourmet restaurants. • 30Avenue (~0.2 miles) • Upscale shopping, dining, and entertainment destination with a chic atmosphere. • Alys Beach (~2 miles) • Stunning architecture, luxury dining, boutique shopping, and events like the Digital Graffiti Festival. • The Big Chill (formerly The Hub) (~5 miles) • A family-friendly venue with outdoor dining, live music, and a giant screen for movies or sports. • Seaside (~10 miles) • Iconic 30A beach town known for its picturesque cottages, gourmet food trucks, boutique shops, and being the filming location for The Truman Show. • Pier Park (~8 miles) • Shopping, dining, and entertainment hub in Panama City Beach. • Camp Helen State Park (~2 miles) • Offers beaches, nature trails, and opportunities for wildlife viewing and kayaking. • Grayton Beach State Park (~14 miles) • Pristine beaches, hiking trails, and coastal dune lakes.
